subject: [COMPANY] Corp's AI Model Development - Solving Data Challenges
text:
Dear [NAME],

I have been following [COMPANY] Corp's expansion closely - in particular the
HD Skin Analysis launch and the expansion into real-time face tracking and
virtual try-on across beauty and fashion. Building proprietary deep
learning models that perform accurately across diverse skin tones, lighting
conditions, and the full range of global users can be a significant data
challenge.

We have been working with companies like Synthesia, Vida ID, and Tractable
to help them solve challenges like this - specifically on the data
curation, annotation, and model evaluation side.

Would you be open to a 15-minute call to explore whether there is any
overlap?

subject: Encord — a few conversations across the data team at [COMPANY]
text:
Hi [NAME],

Over the past couple of weeks I've had conversations with a few people
across the data team - a platform engineer who felt the work we are doing
on the data curation, annotation, and model evaluation side could be
beneficial for the data science team, and a data analyst who was open to
exploring how Encord could be beneficial for final stages of model
validation. I know you are working on improving the organisational elements
of the company so thought to reach out!

We work with Tractable, Automotus, and Toyota on training, curating, and
evaluating their models - and given the work happening at [COMPANY], I
thought it could be a relevant conversation.

Would you be open to a brief 15 minute call on Wednesday or Thursday this
week?

Wishing you a great week ahead!

subject: CV at [COMPANY]
text:
Good afternoon [NAME],

I came across [COMPANY]'s work on the A-BIOMASS camera - specifically
building underwater CV across species and geographies - which is very
interesting work.

We work with teams like Zeitview, Aigen and Abyss Solutions on data
annotation, curation, and model evaluation for similar applied CV
challenges - it would be great to share how we've been working with them
and hear more about how you're approaching that side of things at Ace
Aquatec.

Please let me know if you would be open to speaking for 15 minutes this
week?

subject: [COMPANY] Intro via Colleague - Encord
text:
